acceptance_criteria: DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER and YEAR are investigated individually and a grain is advertised as supported only when contract representation, typed ReportDesign representation, deterministic coverage, compiler representation and candidate validation all pass.

ConfirmedRequirementContract remains the semantic authority and is not changed merely because ReportDesign or compiler capability is incomplete; existing APBRA-143 confirmation and APBRA-144 iterative clarification authority remain unchanged.

ReportDesign uses the minimum domain-neutral typed representation required to bind a trend to its exact temporal field, confirmed grain and confirmed measure identities without prescribing a universal visual type.

Deterministic trend coverage requires exact confirmed measure identity, exact temporal field, compatible explicit time grain, supported representation, required page scope and existing business-question mapping; wrong or missing values fail closed.
A raw Date category binding alone never proves WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER or YEAR semantics, and visual titles, arbitrary prose, field names and scenario names are never semantic authority.
The compiler uses an actual supported Power BI PBIP representation for every claimed grain; fabricated structures and silent grain downgrade are prohibited.
Candidate validation verifies the intended supported grain to the extent the generated PBIP representation permits and clearly distinguishes structural evidence from Power BI Desktop runtime proof.

A grain that cannot be represented safely within the bounded MVP is removed from the advertised capability profile and becomes UNSUPPORTED or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED before human confirmation; a known capability conflict cannot become a post-confirmation technical coverage failure.

The Report Design generation loop retains exactly two total model attempts and one correction opportunity; deterministic rejection supplies exact structured domain-neutral findings and the corrected design is fully revalidated.

Correction findings may identify obligation ID and kind, expected measures, temporal field, time grain, supported capability, page or scope mismatch, missing business-question mapping, invalid citation and exact allowed citation IDs, but never provide a finished design, visual recipe or invented business meaning.
A second invalid Report Design fails closed, and a retry cannot change confirmed business meaning, contract authority or the original design evidence.
DAY and MONTH pass end-to-end representation tests; WEEK, QUARTER and YEAR pass the same five-layer proof when supported or prove pre-confirmation unsupported routing when not supported.
Regression tests reject wrong grain, wrong temporal field, wrong measure, missing trend, raw-date false positives, altered confirmation semantics and incomplete business-question coverage.

Production prompts and logic contain no branching, recipes or assumptions for Sales, Revenue, Sales_Data, Region, Product_Category, ServiceNow, Ticket, Stage, fixture names or any other business domain.
All APBRA-138, APBRA-139, APBRA-141, APBRA-142, APBRA-143 and APBRA-144 controls and regressions remain effective.
